source.citation: Sedra & Smith (2014). Microelectronic Circuits, §17.2 — first-order RC high-pass. f_3dB = 1/(2πRC).

sim_completed.description: 1 if LTspice AC sweep ran without errors, else 0

gain_hf.description: Gain (in dB) at 100 kHz, well above the corner
gain_hf.T_good_source: Ideal high-pass at 100 kHz (>>159 Hz corner): |V(out)/V(in)| → 1.0 → 0 dB. T_good 0.3 dB ≈ 3.5% linear. Oracle measured -1.1e-05 on wine LTspice 26 (2026-04-28).

f_3db.description: Frequency at which |V(out)| rises to 1/√2 of its HF value
f_3db.T_good_source: Closed-form f_3dB = 1/(2π·R·C) = 1/(2π·1k·1µ) = 159.15 Hz; matches simulator. Oracle measured 159.18 on wine LTspice 26 (2026-04-28).
